name: Boon of Goat's Blood
text: ]] The Boon of Goat's Blood is a Boon given to the player during Leshy's Trials in Act I of Inscryption. This places a Black Goat on the players side of the board for the final battle. This allows the player to play any card that costs Blood at the start of the battle.

name: Boon of the Ambidextrous
text: |alt=]] The Boon of the Ambidextrous is a Boon given to the player during Leshy's Trials in Act I of Inscryption. This boon allows you to draw twice at the beginning of your turn, from either deck. This helps heighten your chances of getting good cards from your normal deck, or can draw twice from your Side Deck to get more sacrifice outlets. However, this also helps drain cards, causing Starvation to come in quicker.

name: Boon of the Bone Lord
text: |alt=]] The Boon of the Bone Lord is a Boon given to the player during Leshy's Trials, or during the Bone Lord event if given a Black Goat in Act I of Inscryption. This boon gives the player 8 Bones at the start of all battles. This helps to easily play any bone card at the start of your turn.

name: Boon of the Forest
text: |alt=]] The Boon of the Forest is a Boon given to the player during Leshy's Trials in Act I of Inscryption. This boon places Grand Firs on all your spaces at the start of the final battle. This gives you a good amount of time to draw cards and plan for the next few turns, and if the trees are not destroyed by your 3rd turn, they will be turned into Gold Nuggets and provide further protection.

name: Boon of the Magpie's Eye
text: |alt=]] The Boon of the Magpie's Eye is a Boon given to the player during Leshy's Trials in Act I. This boon allows the player to, when drawing from their deck, chose any card from their deck to draw. This bypasses the randomness and risk of drawing from your deck, hoping for a powerful card. This mimics the Hoarder ability on the Magpie card, hence the name of the boon.

name: Boons
text: Boons are special attributes given to the player during Leshy's Trials in Act I of Inscryption. Boons change the way the final battle works, giving huge buffs to the player. However, these boons do not carry over into your next run if you die. For each trial you pass, three out of the 5 boons will be offered, and the player may choose one.

name: Build-a-Card
text: Build-a-Card is an event in Act III of Inscryption, first encountered in the southwest of the Resplendent Bastion, northwest Botopia. Similarly to the Card Recycle event, the player is prompted to pick a card from their deck to permanently destroy, but instead of gaining Robobucks, the player instead gains 'SP' to spend on making their own card from scratch in a point-buy system.

name: Campfire
text: The Campfire is an Event in Act I of Inscryption. The player meets five survivors gathered around a fire. The survivors invite the player to warm one of their creatures by the fire to make it stronger, but not out of any good faith.

name: Card Battle
text: A Card Battle is the term for a normal battle in Inscryption, taking place in all three Acts & Kaycee's Mod. Battles behave slightly different depending on the Act, but the core gameplay is the same.

name: Card Choice
text: A Card Choice is an event in Act I, Kaycee's Mod and Act III of Inscryption. The player is given a choice of three Cards and must select one of them. In Act I and Kaycee's Mod, there are multiple variants that have specific purposes. If the player has a Clover, they can swap out the cards offered for a new selection.

name: Card Recycle
text: Card Recycle is an event in Act III that allows you to remove a card from your deck in exchange for Robobucks. All cards give 4 Robobucks by default, and give an additional 3 Robobucks for each additional Sigil placed onto them. The source of the Sigil does not matter, however it is important to note that the Sigil must be added to the card. Sigils present on cards by default give no additional Robobucks. The Sigil Power of the individual Sigils does not influence the amount of Robobucks given. Unlike Build-a-Card, Gemifying a card does not give any additional Robobucks.

name: Clover
text: The Clover is a Non-consumable Item that can be used in Act I and Act II of Inscryption, as well as Kaycee's Mod.

name: Consumable Items
text: Consumable items are special objects that can be obtained in Act I, Act III, and Kaycee's Mod of Inscryption. They sit to the right of the game board, and may be used at any time during combat, providing various beneficial effects to the user.

name: Deck Trial
text: A Deck Trial is an event in Act I and Kaycee's Mod of Inscryption. The player arrives at the mouth of a cave, with a strange beast within who offers to join the player if they pass one of its trials.

name: Extra Battery
text: Rulebook: Replenishes Energy up to the current maximum. It's alright.

name: Fish Hook
text: Rulebook: To the user: Hook one of my cards and take it as your own. You must have an empty space on your side to receive it. The Fish Hook is a consumable item in Act I. It allows you to pull one of your opponent's cards to your side of the board, placing it under your control. You must have an empty space on your side of the board in the same lane as the targeted card; if you do not, you cannot use the Fish Hook on that card.

name: Gemification
text: Gemification is an event in Act III of Inscryption that is first encountered in Gaudy Gem Land. The player will be prompted to choose a card, which will then become Gemified.

name: Hammer
text: The Hammer is a tool in Act II and Act III of Inscryption. It can be used on any card on the player's side, including terrain cards, dealing 100 damage to said card. If used on a card with Nano Armor, it will break the Nano Armor first. It will also activate any on death abilities, such as Latchers, Unkillable, and Detonator, assuming the card actually dies from the hit.

name: Harpie's Birdleg Fan
text: Rulebook: To the user: Your creatures will attack as though they have the Airborne sigil this turn.

name: Hoggy Bank
text: Rulebook: To the user: You will immediately gain 4 Bones.

name: Hourglass
text: Rulebook: To the user: Your adversary will entirely skip their next turn.

name: Kaycee's Mod
text: Kaycee's Mod is an official expansion to Act I of Inscryption, modifying the Act into a repeatable roguelike with many unlocks and challenges. It is accessible from the main menu upon beating the game.

name: Leshy's Trials
text: Before facing Leshy in battle in Act I, the player will be given the opportunity to gain up to two boons by passing trials. The player will have to choose between three different trials. In a trial, three cards will be drawn, and at least one of them must satisfy the trial criteria.

name: Magickal Bleach
text: Rulebook: To the user: My cards on the board will lose all of their Sigils.

name: Magpie's Lens
text: Rulebook: To the user: You will search your deck for any card and take it into your hand.

name: Minor Boon of the Bone Lord
text: The Minor Boon of the Bone Lord is a Boon obtainable through the Bone Lord event in Act I of Inscryption. It is given if the player sacrifices any card, excluding the Black Goat or any Pelts. One Bone will be given the player at the start of every round for each of this Boon obtained.

name: Mrs. Bomb's Remote
text: Mrs. Bomb's Remote is an item in Act III of Inscryption. When used, it deploys Explode Bots on every empty space.

name: Mycologist's Hut
text: The Mycologist's Hut is an area in Inscryption's second act. Within it reside The Mycologists, who ask the player to give them sets of specific cards so they can experiment on them. These cards are Field Mice, Gravedigger, Sentry Drone, & Blue Mage.

name: Nano Armor Generator
text: The Nano Armor Generator is an Item in Act III of Inscryption. When used, it will give all cards on your side of the board Nano Armor if they do not already possess it.

name: Pliers
text: Rulebook: To the user: You will place a weight on the scales. The pain is temporary.

name: Scissors
text: Rulebook: To the user: You may cut up one of your adversary's cards. It is destroyed.

name: Skinning Knife
text: Rulebook: To the user: You may skin one of your adversary's cards. It is destroyed and you draw a Pelt card.

name: Special Dagger
text: The Special Dagger is an item in Act I of Inscryption. When used, it adds a weight worth 4 points to the scale in your favor, at the cost of your right eye. Your vision will be impaired for the rest of the battle, but Leshy will let you choose a new eye when it ends. It is semi-unique, as while you can obtain it several times in a run, you can never have more than one copy of the Dagger at any given time.

name: Wiseclock
text: Rulebook: To the user: All creatures on the board will rotate one space clockwise.

name: Adder
text: Keywords: Touch of Death. Traits: KillsSurvivors.

name: Black Goat
text: Keywords: Worthy Sacrifice. Traits: Goat.

name: Caged Wolf
text: Traits: DeathcardCreationNonOption. Special behaviour: When a card perishes (but not sacrificed), it is removed from player's deck, and Wolf is created in its place and added to player's deck.

name: Child 13 (Dormant)
text: Keywords: Many Lives. Traits: JeresyDevil, Cat. Special behaviour: When a card is sacrificed, it switches between portraits and receives/loses temporary modifier that increases Power by 2 and adds Airborne Sigil. Sacrificing for 14th time will kill the card, as if it didn't have the Many Lives Sigil.

name: Child 13 (Awakened)
text: Keywords: Airborne, Many Lives. Traits: Child 13, Limited Lives.

name: Boulder
text: Sigils: Made Of Stone (In Kaycee's Mod).

name: Blue Sporemage
text: Keywords: Mental Gemnastics, Mental Gemnastics. Traits: Fused.

name: Amalgam (Act II)
text: Power: Varies (default: 1). Sigils: Varies (default: none).

name: Broken Obol (Left)
text: Keywords: Sharp Quills. Traits: If placed on the left of the right Obol, gives the player one Ancient Obol..

name: Broken Obol (Right)
text: Keywords: Bone King. Traits: If placed on the right of the left Obol, gives the player one Ancient Obol..

name: Captive File
text: Keywords: Hostage File. Power: Varies. 1 by Default.

name: Bounty Hunter
text: Power: Varies. Sigils: Varies.

name: Glitched card
text: Power: variable. Sigils: variable. Special behaviour: When a card is drawn, it is replaced with a random unlocked card for the current battle.

name: Spore Mice
text: Keywords: Fecundity, Fecundity. Traits: Fused.

name: Sporedigger
text: Keywords: Bone Digger, Bone Digger. Traits: Fused.

name: Friend
text: Power: Varies. Sigils: Varies.

name: Long Elk
text: Keywords: Sprinter, Touch of Death. Traits: KillsSurvivors.

name: Mole
text: Keywords: Burrower. The omnipresent Mole. It burrows and emerges to block any landborne attacker.

name: Pack Mule
text: Keywords: Sprinter, Uncuttable. Special behaviour: When a card perishes, player receives a Squirrel, a Card that Costs 1 Blood, a Card that Costs 2 Blood, and a Card that Costs Bones (or another Card that Costs 1 Blood, if Bones haven't been unlocked yet).

name: Ouroboros
text: Keywords: Unkillable, Satisfies Ring Trial. Special behaviour: A card's base Power and Health are permanently incremented by 1 each time card perishes.

name: Ourobot
text: Keywords: Unkillable. Special behaviour: A card's base Power and Health are permanently incremented by 1 each time card perishes.

name: Pelts (Rabbit)
text: Special behaviour: When a card is played, Pelt Lice from hand/deck are played in adjacent slots for free.

name: Pelts (Wolf)
text: Special behaviour: When a card is played, Pelt Lice from hand/deck are played in adjacent slots for free.

name: Pelts (Golden)
text: Special behaviour: When a card is played, Pelt Lice from hand/deck are played in adjacent slots for free.

name: Ijiraq
text: Keywords: Repulsive. Special behaviour: A card will mimic a random card in your deck, only revealing itself when played.

name: Pelt Lice
text: Keywords: Double Strike. Traits: Lice.

name: Mycobot
text: Power: Varies. Sigils: Varies.

text: Traits: DeathCardNonOption.

name: Starvation
text: Power: 1+. Sigils: Repulsive. 5th Starvation onward: Airborne.

name: Stinkbug
text: Keywords: Stinky. Traits: DeathcardCreationNonOption.

name: Stunted Wolf
text: Traits: DeathcardCreationNonOption.

name: Daus
text: Keywords: Bellist. Traits: Chime Keeper. Special behaviour: If a card with "bell" in its internal ID (Chime, Bell Tentacle) is attacked, a card with this Behaviour will strike the offending card.

name: Daus (Act III)
text: Keywords: Bellist. Special behaviour: If a card with "bell" in its internal ID (Chime, Bell Tentacle) is attacked, a card with this Behaviour will strike the offending card.

name: Ring Worm
text: Keywords: Satisfies Ring Trial. Traits: KillsSurvivors, DeathcardCreationNonOption.

name: The Moon
text: Keywords: Mighty Leap, Omni Strike, Tidal Lock, Uncuttable. Traits: Giant (Increases its Power by 1 every turn after all cards are drawn). Special behaviour: When a card is spawned on the board, it replaces all spaces on opponent's side of the board with itself. When a card perishes, it clears all spaces on opponent's side of the board.

name: Strange Frog
text: Keywords: Mighty Leap. Special behaviour: When a card perishes, it spawns a Leaping Trap in its place.

name: Sentry Spore
text: Keywords: Sentry, Sentry. Traits: Fused.

name: The Limoncello
text: Keywords: Mighty Leap, Omni Strike, Made Of Stone, Uncuttable. Traits: Giant. Special behaviour: When a card is spawned on the board, it replaces all spaces on opponent's side of the board with itself. When a card perishes, it clears all spaces on opponent's side of the board. Once a card has less than 70 Health, each turn one Skeleton Crew per 5 damage taken since last turn will drop onto player's side of the board (if there are free slots).

name: Cat
text: Keywords: Many Lives. Special behaviour: A card will turn into Undead Cat when sacrificed 9 times.
